property_summary: Because msg.value is already credited to address(this).balance before the body runs, the reference's transfer of balance+msg.value exceeds the actual balance and the whole multiplicate call must revert for any msg.value > 0; the mutant (sending only msg.value) instead succeeds for such calls.
change_summary: Transfer only msg.value instead of the full balance plus msg.value.
